dct_description_sm: The focus of this project was to collect bathymetric data for the purpose of mapping community water supplies and determining the volume of potable water. More specifically, the project aimed to (1) gather information to determine the volume of water supplies in Arviat and Whale Cove and gather information on their physical characteristics so that they can be mapped; (2) determine the charge/discharge rate of the water supply in Arviat and Whale Cove and map the charge sources and discharge points; (3) involve communities in climate change research and provide a community awareness to change; (4) train Nunavummiut in climate change data collection and use of equipment; (5) provide employment for Nunavummiut (6) and; provide assistance to on-going Nunavut Climate Change Adaptation Plan research in Iqaluit as required by Natural Resources Canada.
dct_title_s: Addressing Climate Change Adaptation: A Collaborative Approach in Support of the Nunavut Climate Change Adaptation Plan-Watershed Analysis of Drinking Water Supplies in Nunavut Project
